name: git_push
description: Push an exact candidate branch (upstream tracking; --force-with-lease only when asked). Non-retryable remote auth/policy rejection completes with pushed=false and a retained local branch.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git checkout to push from.

branch.description: Local branch to push. Defaults to the checkout's current branch when omitted.

destinationBranch.description: Remote branch name to push to, if different from the local branch name.

remote.description: Remote name to push to; ignored if remoteUrl is set.

remoteUrl.description: Remote URL/name to push to; takes precedence over remote.

setUpstream.description: Pass --set-upstream (only when the remote is a plain name, not a URL/SSH spec).

forceWithLease.description: Push with --force-with-lease. A bare --force is never used.

expectedHead.description: Candidate-bound push: the local branch must still resolve to this commit SHA, which is used as the source side of the refspec, preventing a later local commit from being published under an earlier verification result.

pushed.description: True if the push succeeded; false if a non-retryable remote auth/policy rejection was classified (task still completes, not FAILED).

destinationBranch.description: Remote branch name pushed to. Only present when pushed=true.

remote.description: Remote name or URL pushed to.

head.description: Commit SHA pushed (or retained local HEAD when pushed=false).

candidateBound.description: True when expectedHead was supplied and the push was bound to that exact commit. Only present when pushed=true.

publicationState.description: Classification of a non-retryable rejection. Only present when pushed=false.

retryable.description: Always false when present; signals the caller should not retry this push as-is. Only present when pushed=false.

reason.description: Credential-free, stable explanation of the rejection. Only present when pushed=false.
